tei:div.tei:p: ༅/ /ma hā sa n+dhi a bhi ra sa tsi t+taṃ ti la kā bhi ṣi ta bi dho mṛ taṃ no bṛ ṣa

ḍi ti sma/ //༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po lce btsun snying tig gi dbang chog bdud rtsi'i gru char bzhugs so/ ༄༅༅/ /na mo gu ru mū la s+yai/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gshegs shul gsang chen lam/ /rang grol 'odagasal rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /gdams bzang snang mdzad brgyud gsum rig 'dzin gyi/ /ngo bo dpal mgon bla mar gus phyag 'tshal/ /man ngag bcud ldan rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /snod ldan slob ma'i sgo gsum cha mnyam rgyu/ /rdo rje bzhi ru smin byed thabs zab mo/ /dbang chog bdud rtsi'i gru char 'dir gsal bya/ /de la 'dir bi ma la'i zab tig lce btsun snying tig gi dbang bskur ba la gsum/ gang du bya ba'i gnas/ nam bya ba'i dus/ ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /dang po rgyal bas zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas byin che ba'am/ dpyad legs mthun rkyen 'dzoms shing bkra shis pa'i gnas/ dur khrod dam/ ri rtse 'am/ gangs ltang ngam/ mtsho gling sogs shin tu dben zhing zil che ba'i gnas su'o/ /gnyis pa tshes bcu sogs dus khyad par can gyi tshe/ gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang po 'dzom dus su bya ba la 'jug /gsum pa la'ang gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ thog mar dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sa phyogs ma dul ba yin na/ gzhi de nyid du gtor ma dkar zlum rgyan ldan mchod pa dang bcas pa bsham/ slob dpon bdag nyid rang bzhin gzhi'i kun tu bzang po las bla ma he ru ka'i skur bzhengs pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang nyid skad cig gis rta mchog he ru ka khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar bar gyur par bsam/ gtor ma rta sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes mkha' lding gi rgya bcas lan gsum gyis brlab/

bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga to sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis bsngos/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'dir/ /bdag zhu khyaid kyis stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par mos la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra gats+tshaḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs la gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ de nas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas rtse gsum rgya sa gzhi la reg ste/ rtsa ba'i sngags brgya'am nyer gcig bzlas pas kun rdzob kyi sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad stong nyid du shes pas rang bzhin med par rgyas btab pa ni don dam pa'i sbyang ba'o/ /gnyis pa la'ang gnyis/ dang po/ stegs bu'i dbus su 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bum pa a yis mtshan pa: de'i steng du bhan+dha bdud rtsis bkang ba dang : rdo rje sems dpa'i me long rnams brtsegs mar bsham: gzhan yang lha yi nyer spyod mchod tshogs rgyas pa dang*/ bdag gi nyer spyad/ rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ nas bzed/ bskrad bdug gi rdzas/ nang mchod rnams 'du bya/ gnyis pa la'ang gnyis/ cho ga dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos so/ /dang po/ kun bzang don gyi phrin las gzhung bsrangs te cho ga gcig gi khong du bdag mdun bum gsum thol bskyed kyis bzlas pa grub nas/ las bum nang du dbang chen rta mgrin skad cig gis gsal btab la/ oṃ badz+ra krau dhā h+yā grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces ci rigs par bzlas mthar/ las bum gyi khro bos bar chad kyi bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces 'dod don gsol/ bdag 'jug rig me dor bas 'thus so/ /gnyis pa la'ang gnyis gyi dang po/ /dam tshig bsrung zhing sgrub par nus nges pa'i slaub ma gcig gam gsum mam/ bdun las mi mang bar gsungs pas de ltar ram/ lar snod dang ldan mi ldan gyi khyad par shes par bya dgos la/

gang ltar thog mar phyi rol du las slob kyis khrus bya/ gral du 'khod ma thag /bgegs gtor las chus bsangs te/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes mkha' lding gi rgya bcas lan gsum brlab/ sarba bigh+nāṃ a kar+ṣa ya dza sa bgegs bkug /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo sogs swā hā/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang se gol bcas lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ aḥ yid byed ltar snang bgegs ky-i tshogs: rang bzhin bden med gtor ma longs: 'khor yug 'od gsal phyag rgya las: mi 'da' rdo rje'i mtshams bcad do: hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥ zhes pas bgegs bskrad la gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ bsrung 'khor ni/ bgegs rnams phar bskrad de 'od zer tshur 'dus pa las steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me dpung dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo cis kyang mi chod mi shigs pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur par bsam/ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ de nas chos bshad pas mtshams sbyar ba ni/ de ltar na slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas/ dag pa khrus nas ma bton par/ /gsang sngags dbang gi sgo mi dbye/ /byur dang mi shis ma bsal bar/ /gsang sngags dbang gi gral mi gtod/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo ma bsgoms par/ /gsang sngags dbang gi chos mi bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar grub zin pa lags/ gnyis pa kun slong bcos shing nges shes bskyed pa ni/ 'o na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi 'jug sgo dang po smin byed kyi dbang legs par gsan te/ grol byed gdams pa'i rim pa tshul bzhin nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i dam bca' brtan po'i sgo nas mdo rgyud rin po che rnams nas ji skad gsungs pa ltar kun slong dang kun spyod kyi rim pa rnams thugs la bcang ste gzhan du ma yengs par gsan 'tshal/

da lam rang re rnams skye dka' ba lho rgyal 'dzam bu'i gling*/ thob dka' ba sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i rten khyad par can dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che/ mjal dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che/ 'phrad dka' ba gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol zab mo dang*/ de ston byed bla ma rdo rje slob dpon gyis rjes su bzung ba'i gnas skabs 'di lta bu ni dper na u dum+bā ra'i me tog las kyang ches cher dkon pas na/ nges shes dang bcas pa'i dad pa ni sngags kyi dngos grub thob byed kyi rgyu ma nor ba yin te/ /o rgyan rin po ches/ da res phun tshogs rkyen kun 'byor dus 'dir/ /brtson 'grus drag pos srid las 'da' bar mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sna tshogs pa'i rten 'brel 'dzom pa'i dus 'dir le lo gsum gyi dbang du mi btang bar dal khoms med pa'i brtson 'grus gsum gyi sgo nas gdams pa nyams su ma blangs na/ spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad kyi rang bzhin can yin la/ khyad par du rang re lus sems kyi tshogs pa 'di yang mi rtag par nges par 'chi ba/ nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi rkyen nges med las ma 'das pas na/ skad cig kyang phyi bshol du ma song bas chos la 'bad pa gal che ste/ ji skad du/ 'di ltar srid pa'i bde sdug mtho dman kun/ /sngon bsags las las grub par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shi ba'i dus las gang byas kyi 'bras bu chud mi za bas na/ mi dge ba'i las kyis ngan song dang*/ dge ba'i las kyis mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur la/ 'gro ba gang du skyes kyang zo chu'i 'khyud mo bzhin sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ sdug bsngal gyi yo lang kho na las ma 'das pas/ da ni srid pa'i sdug bsngal las thar ba zhig nges par dgos/ de yang rang gcig pu tsam zhi bde don gnyer gyi bsam pa ma yin par khams gsum gyi gnas su 'khyams shing sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis kyis rtag tu mnar ba'i ma sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched du theg pa chen po'i blos lam la zhugs pa'i phan yon tshad med de/

ji skad du/ sems can khams ni tshad med pa/ /phan 'dod de ni 'dra'o/ /zhes so/ /thob bya sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de yang rgyu med rkyen med du mi thob pas na/ rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo mdo sngags gnyis las/ 'di ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam khyad par can yin la/ de la'ang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul na gsar rnying zhes ris med kyang bod 'dir lo tsā ba byon snga phyi'i dbang gis/ snga 'gyur rnying ma dang*/ phyi 'gyur gsar ma'i tha snyad du grags pa las/ 'di ni snga 'gyur rnying ma yin/ de la'ang*/ bskyed pa ma hā yo ga gzhi lta bu/ rdzogs pa a nu yo ga lam lta bu/ rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga 'bras bu lta bu ste nang rgyud sde gsum du bzhugs pa las/ 'di ni phyi ma ste/ de la'ang*/ sems sde/ klong sde/ man ngag sde dang gsum du dbye ba'i 'di ni man ngag sde yin la/ de la'ang yul dang gdams ngag gi zab khyad nang gses su dbye ba bzhir mchis pa'i nang nas 'di ni yang gsang bla na med pa man ngag snying tig ste/ de la'ang bka' gter gyi lugs gnyis su bzhugs pa las/ 'di na gter ma'o/ /de la 'ang gnyis/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i bka' srol las byung ba'i man ngag mkha' 'gro snying tig chen mo dang*/ paṇa chen bi ma la'i bka' srol las byung ba'i man ngag bi ma snying tig ste/ 'di ni phyi ma'i rjes su 'brel ba'i man ngag thams cad kyi rgyal po klong lnga'i yi ge dum bu gsum pa lce btsun chen po'i bi ma la'i zab tig gi sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin par byed pa la/ lo rgyus kyi sgo nas nges shes skyed pa/ dbang gi sgo nas smin par byed pa/ gdams ngag gi sgo nas grol bar byed pa dang gsum yod pas/ thog mar lo rgyus 'chad dgos pa ni/ rgyud klong gsal las/ lo rgyus don gyis ma bshad na/ /gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/

de la ring brgyud/ nye brgyud/ shin tu nye brgyud kyi lo rgyus khyad par du dbye ba las/ dang po ring brgyud la gsum ste/ ji skad du/ rgyal ba sems dpa' rnal 'byor pa/ /dgongs pa rig pa rna bar brgyud/ /gang la thug gi bar du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gdod ma'i mgon po dpal kun tu bzang po/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje sogs dgongs klong 'du 'bral med pa'i tshul gyis brgyud pa dang*/ gnyis pa rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku mchog dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ rig 'dzin chen po shrī seng ha/ paṇa chen dzñā na sū tra/ paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra dang*/ o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bar du brda' bstan pa tsam gyis rtogs grol dus mnyam du byung bas so/ /gsum pa gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra bod du byon nas/ mnga' bdag rje 'bangs lnga dang khyad par du nyang ting 'dzin bzang po la rjes su gdams/ nyang gis snyan rgyud rnams sbas blo gros dbang phyug la gnang*/ dpe rgyud rnams dbu ru zhwa'i lha khang du gter du sbas/ phyis nyang rang gi rnam sprul sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po gnas brtan ldang ma lhun grub rgyal mtshan gyis spyan drangs nas lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug la gnang ba nas bzung*/ rim par brgyud de kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dri med 'od zer la bka' babs shing*/ de las bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa dang*/ gnyis pa nye brgyud ni/ kun mkhyen chen po de nyid la paṇa chen bi ma las byin gyis brlabs shing dgongs pa'i gter mdzod brdol ba la brten nas bla ma yang tig yid bzhin nor bu sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i shing rta'i lam srol rmad du byung ba dbye bar mdzad cing smin grol gyi gdams pa bar ma chad par bzhugs pa brgyud pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa lags/

gsum pa/ shin tu nye brgyud gdams ngag 'di nyid gy-i dbang du byas na/ sngon byung gi lo rgyus ni/ gzhung rtsa ba las: 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na: bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzugs kyi rgyal po dang : tshor ba'i rgyal po dang : 'du shes kyi rgyal po dang : 'du byed kyi rgyal po dang : rnam par shes pa'i rgyal po rnams gcig tu bsdus pa'i ye shes kyi sku brnyes pa dpal he ru ka rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug siṃ he shwa ra de nyid: pad+ma'i rigs mchog gar gyi dbang po'i zhing khams: bod kha ba can gyi ljongs: yul la ming du chags pa 'o yul shug pa'i gling gi mgo: bkra shis la zil che ba: byin chags la rlung rig dwangs pa: mkha' 'gro phyi gong rdza'i rwa ba sman shing nags kyi tshal chen por bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho la snyoms par zhugs so: de'i tshe de'i dus na lan cig ston zla ra ba'i tshes bcu la ye shes dang : las dang : 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma sprin bzhin du gtibs nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i 'du ba rgya chen po la longs spyod pa'i tshe: o rgyan gyi ḍā ki'i gtso mo dpal gyi blo gros mas rdo rje'i lta bas bltas te: phyag rnal 'byor gyi lugs su btsal nas 'di skad ces gsol to: e ma e ma: ma 'ongs pa'i tshe na snying tig snying po'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis nyams len gyi mthar thug gang la bgyi: phrin las gyi gzhung gang ltar bsrang : snying po'i mthar thug gang du la bzla zhes gsol ba na: shri he ru ka siṃ he shwa ra nyid dar cig dbyings ka dag zang thal kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas sku mi snang ba 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur to: de'i tshe mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis: kye ma kye hud kye ma klong : ston pa sgron me'i 'od nub na: 'jig rten mun pa gang gis sel:

ye shes sku yi nyi ma yis: ma rig 'thib po bsal du gsol: rdo rje'i gsung gi bdud rtsi yis: 'khor ba'i tsha gdung bsil bar mdzod: ces gsol ba btab pas lhun grub rig rtsal gyi ting nge 'dzin la 'phos pa'i de ma thag par ye shes kyi sku mngon sum du snang bar mdzad nas chos nyid rdo rje'i rang sgra 'di skad ces bka' stsal to: e ma e ma ma 'ongs pa phyi ma phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe snying tig snying po'i don la spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis tshe 'di kho na la grol bar 'dod na lce btsun siṃ he shwa ra bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o: zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gnyis pa phyis 'byung 'gyur lung bstan pa ni/ de nyid las/ 'di ni ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga ches bdo zhing bod khams kla klo'i 'jug pas bstan zhabs sdud pa la nye ba na: snying tig snying po'i don la mos pa'i rnal 'byor pa: ltar snang tha mal pa rnams dang shin tu mnyam par spyod pa: gsang ba sus kyang brtag par dka' ba: chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur nyams 'og tu tshud pas gang gis kyang zil gyis mi non pa: smin mtshams su dpa' bo'i rgya rtags kyis spras pa: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi byin gyis brlabs pas thug phrad shes rab kyi gter brdol ba: khyad par nges pa'i don la nges shes rnyed cing bdag dang bdag gi bka' srol zol med pa kho na la mos pa mi 'phrog par brtan pa 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba dus ring mo nas 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i don du bstan te: de'i phyir de'i slad du: re zhig ye shes kyi dhā ki ma rnams kyis klong lnga'i yi ger zung la: dus la babs pa'i tshe gang zag de'i rgyud la byin gyis brlabs pas sad par gyis shig: skal ldan gcig car ba'i rigs can 'ga' zhig la phan par 'gyur ro: zhes lung byang dang mthun par 'phags pa 'jam dpal mi yi rgyal po'i zol du sprul pa/ gnam lha babs kyi rgyal po/

/sa lhun grub kyi mnga' bdag /bod mgo nag gi rje bo/ /chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi thugs bskyed kyi 'bras bu dus su smin pa/ snyigs dus skye rgu yongs kyi skyabs mgon ris med rgyal bstan yongs kyi mnga' bdag /snga 'gyur bka' babs bdun gyi shing rta chen po/ /sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba/ /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po/ /mtshan brjod par dka' ba/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'am pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa zhes mtshan tsam thos pa 'ang don dang ldan pa de nyid dgungs grangs nyer bzhir son pa chu mo yos kyi lo'i snron zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyin/ 'o yug gi mthil/ ram lding ma dgon dang nye bar phebs pa'i tshe/ tha mal gyi snang ba dbyings su thim pas/ 'od gsal gyi snang char lce btsun chen po 'od lus su gshegs pa'i gnas dus ston 'khor gyi tshom bu'i bkod pa ji lta ba bzhin gsal bar shar zhing man ngag gi gzhung bka' stsal ba thugs la bkra lam gyis sad pa ltar rjes su dran pa'i gter kha dang mthun par gtan la phab cing shin tu gsang ba'i rgyas btab ste/ phyis dgungs grangs so brgyad du son pa me mo sbrul gyi lor sngags srung e ka dza ṭīs gsang sgo dbye bar bskul ba ltar/ 'dzam gling chos kyi shing rta chen po mjam mgon blo gros mtha' yas dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dpal karma pa chen po theg mchog rdo rje/ sprul pa'i gter ston chen po mchog gyur bde chen gling pa sogs lung zin mkhas grub kyi skyes chen dam pa rnams la rim par bstsal zhing*/ phyis su rje dgungs grangs nga dgur son pa sa pho stag gi lor tha skar zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin kho bo cag brtse bas rjes su bzung ste smin grol tshang sprugs su gnang ba lags/ gnyis pa dbang gi sgo nas smin par byed pa la/ thal 'gyur las/

dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yis kyang*/ /skal bar ldan pa smin par bya/ /spros bcas nyid dang spros pa med/ /shin tu spros pa med pa dang*/ /de bzhin rab tu spros pa med/ /dbye ba bzhi yi tshul gyis ni/ /dad ldan rang rgyud smin par bya/ /zhes dang*/ de nas rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams rim par 'byung bas/ de la'ang slob dpon dang slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams legs par grub zin pa lags/ da slob ma khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i ched du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/

gser gyi me tog dang bcas pas maṇ+ḍal phul bcug la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen yin te/ /'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas/ /zhes pas/ /dad mos dang ldan pa'i phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo snying gar sbyor la gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kye kye bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon: bdag la thugs rjes dgongs su gsol: dri med bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis: ye shes smin cing bskyed du gsol: gnas lugs rang zhal mthong ba dang : mngon sum rig pa bstan du gsol: lan gsum zhu'o: de la slob dpon gyis: phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan te/ de ltar zhu ba'i don 'di la gsan pas khyab ste/ e ma rigs kyi bu: rang bzhin theg mchog rgyal po'i sgor zhugs pa la: dam tshig gi gnas gcan 'phrang dang 'dra ba ni shin tu srung bar dka' na: srog la babs kyang srung bar nus sam: sgrub pa snying por mi byed na gdams ngag chud 'dza' zhing mkha' 'gro rnams 'khrugs par 'gyur bas: rtse gcig tu sgrub par bgyid dam: zhes dris pa la: slob ma rnams kyis dam tshig gi gnas snying dang mig ltar bsrung*/ sgrub pa'i snying po gdams ngag tu dril te nyams su len par bgyi'o snyam pa'i khas blang ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma bla ma rin po che: theg mchog rgyal po'i sgor zhugs nas: srog la babs kyang dam tshig bsrung : snying po'i sgrub pa tshul bzhin bgyi: zhes gsol pa la: dam chu sbyin pa ni: de nas sbyor ba dam la bzhag par bya ba'i slad du dam tshig gi bdud rtsi'i mna' chu 'di nyid lce la bzhag pas rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par gyur nas snying dbus su thim par mos shig /badz+ra sa ma ya a mṛ ta ṭha ṭha ṭha: zhes pas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi sbyin: de ltar btung bas dam tshig nyams na chu de nyid sdig pa mgo dgur gyur nas tshe 'di la snying khrag 'jibs nas mthong chos su tshe thung zhing nad mang ba dang mi 'dod pa du mas mnar zhing srog dang bral/

phyi ma na rag dmyal ba'i gnas su ltung nas sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba myong bar 'gyur la/ dam tshig bsrung na ye shes sems dpar gyur nas rtag tu byin gyis rlob cing 'di phyi'i phan bde ma lus pa 'grub nges pas khe nyen shin tu che bas dam tshig las mi 'da' ba'i phyir rdo rje'i bro bor ba'i sngags 'di'i rjes zlos gyis shig /badz+ra sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes rdo rje'i bro bor du gzhug go: de nas bla mas: e ma rigs kyi bu rnams: 'di ltar 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag pa ste chu'i lbu ba lta bu'o: 'khor ba'i bde ba thams cad ni 'phral bde ba ltar snang yang don la sdug bsngal te dug gi 'bras bu smin pa lta bu'o: rkyen sna tshogs pa thams cad ni zin pa'i dus med pa ste smig rgyu'i chu la bsnyegs pa lta bu'o: tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad ni rnam pa kun tu don med pa ste gnyid thun gcig gi rmi lam bzang ngan lta bu'o: thar pa dam pa'i 'bras bu ni nam yang sdug bsngal bar mi ldog ste 'brum nad byang ba'i skyes bu lta bu'o: bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag ni thar ba'i khang bzang du 'dzegs pa'i lam ste them skas bzang po lta bu'o: rnam par mi rtog pa'i bsam gtan ni ting nge 'dzin thams cad skye ba'i gzhi ste zhing sa dul ba lta bu'o: e ma rigs kyi bu: de'i phyir nges 'byung gi blo bskyed: lus sems khong lhod: mig har re zhog: sems rtog med kyi ngang du dar cig mnyam par 'jog mdzod: zhes dar cig bzhag bcug la/ de la sems zin pa na skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed sgrib sbyong tshogs bsags rnams kyi thabs kyis bzung ngo : zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rang lugs la kun rdzob dmigs pa'i rnam pa dang*/ don dam yongs shes kyi skyabs su 'gro tshul gnyis las/ dang po khyed rang rnams kyis mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i slob dpon chen po bi ma mi tra sku mdog dkar gsal zhabs skyil krung*/

phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gis thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bsnams pa/ dbu la sde snod gsum zhwa/ sku la nang du gsang gos sngon po phu dung dpung ba'i phyed kar lhags pa/ de'i steng du chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ 'od dang 'od zer mu mtha' med par 'phro ba/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor dmigs la/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad dengs nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar mos pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ don dam par chos nyid ye grol sor bzhag byar med rang rig rang snang rang grol sku gsum ye rdzogs chen por bzhugs pa la yin lugs shes pa'i ngang du la bzla ba'i tshul te rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'i sgo nas 'di yi rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ aḥ ka dag gting gsal chos kyi sku: lhun grub rig rtsal longs spyod rdzogs: dbyer med thugs rje sprul pa'i skur: rang ngo shes pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ spy-ir nam mkha'i mthas gtug pa'i mar gyur sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te/ bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan 'dod kyi tshad med bzhi bsgom pa smon sems dang*/ de'i rgyu lag tu blangs shing sgrub pa 'jug sems te kun rdzob kyi rnam pa dang*/ don dam par chos thams cad gdod nas rnam par dag pa la/ glo bur dri mas bsgribs te ma rig 'khrul pas gzhan dbang du song ba'i sems can thams cad ye grol rang rig 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i dbyings su ngal bso ba'i phyir shes pa so ma der 'dzin blo bral rgya yan lhug par cog ger 'jog pa ni don gyi sems bskyed de rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'i sgo nas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ glo bur 'khrul pa'i 'gro ba kun: gdod nas rnam dag dbyings kyi ngang : ye shes rig pas rang grol phyir: cog bzhag chen por sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ tshogs zhing sngar gsal bzhin pa'i drung du yul de dag gi yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu la gcig tu gus pas sems can thams cad dang 'jug pa gcig pa'i sgo nas lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul te phyag 'tshal ba dang*/

dngos su 'byor pa dang*/ yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin zhing rab 'byams su gang bar dmigs te 'bul ba dang*/ stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas sdig ltung bshags pa dang*/ skye 'phags kyi dge ba la phrag dog med pas rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ theg pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ gang sku mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa/ dge tshogs rgya mtsho byang chub snying por yongs su bsngo ba ste/ kun rdzob dmigs pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ don dam par 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po tshig gis mtshon pa'i sgo nas nges shes dang bcas pa ste/ rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pas rjes zlos lan gsum gnang bar zhu/ aḥ snang bzhi mthar phyin bla ma la: 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal lo: rlung sems dag pa'i mchod sprin 'bul: sdig ltung 'dus ma byas par bshags: gnyis 'dzin bral bas rjes yi rang : brjod med chos 'khor bskor bzhin du: yongs grub chen por bzhugs gsol 'debs: dge tshogs 'od gsal dbyings su bsngo: lan gsum/ gzhan yang 'di'i skabs su dpon slob gnyis ka'i rgyud dag pa shin tu gal che bas so so'i gral nas bzhengs te 'gyod sdom drag po'i sgo nas brkyang phyag dang bcas te tshul bzhin sgrub par zhu/ zhes brda sbyar la/ oṃ: ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni: zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang : thugs rje'i nyi gsal 'od bzhin snyoms mdzad pa'i: 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol: brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso: thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya che rol pa yi: zhi khro sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyi rnam sprul pa'i: kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis: mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya chen yongs bkod de: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod:

kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga la: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus kun: 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du ro gcig pas: gnyis med byang chub sems kyis mnyes gyur cig: sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che: chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing : rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsam las 'das pas: mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud: kun bzang rdzogs chen ye nas brdal ba la: phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni: snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings: 'byung dang 'byung gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams: gsang chen rab rgyas gzugs can bdag nyid ma: mkha' dbyings klong yangs pad mo 'khyil ba la: gnyis med thig le chen por 'od gsal zhing : ma bcos spros med byang chub snying po'i sku: cir yang snang ba bde chen g.yung drung lha: 'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni: bdag nyid chen po rigs lnga yab yum dang : byang chub lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs: rdo rje lha mo tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag: rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu: gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi: ye shes sprul pa'i lha tshogs mang po dang : ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs: legs nyes stang 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i: phyi nang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs: dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol: rdo rje gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: 'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed de: bla med byang chub go 'phang thob bya'i phyir: bstan pa rgya mtsho so so'i 'dul khrims dang : sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog: 'da' ka rdo rje dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer: spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams: snga phyir mnos shing gnyer du smras so 'tshal: yun tu mi btang 'da' bar mi bgyid la: don las gol zhing ldog sems ma mchis kyang :

gzod bya long yod snyam pa'i le lo yis: klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang : shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur te: bsgom la mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel la sogs: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la: tshor dang ma tshor ma rig dbang gis ni: ston pa'i bka' dang dam las 'gal gyur te: rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig nyams pa dang : skad cig tsam yang 'phrad par mi bya'o zhes: bka' las byung yang de ltar ma rtogs te: gsang sgo 'chol bas dbye gsal dka' ba dang : mngon shes chung bas skyon can ma rtogs te: nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams pa bskang ba dang : nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang : nyams la mi 'dzem nyams pa'i skyon la sogs: nyams dang 'grogs shing nyams pa de dag gis: nyams sgrib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal: tshe 'di'i rkyen dang yun gyi sgrib gyur rnams: rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol bshags na: byams pa'i thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang : gnyis med dbyings su mi 'gyur bdag bkod de: mi dmigs btang snyoms ngang la bzhugs nas kyang : gnyis med don gyis tshangs pa stsal du gsol: don dam dmigs med spros las 'das pa la: rnam rtog gang yang dmigs par ma gyur te: kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi dbang gis na: nongs pa mchis na rang gnong bzod par gsol: na raka bshags pa ni/ e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi kun gyi bdag nyid che: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs dgongs: 'dir gshegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: nyams chag na raka sbyangs phyir phyag mchod bzhes: yon tan phun tshogs bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: dmigs med spraus bral chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gro mgon cir yang sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: gnas lugs mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: yang dag mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo:

nyon mongs zhi mdzad zhi ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: log lta tshar gcod khro bo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: thabs mgon tshe bdag 'jam dpal sku la phyag 'tshal lo: skyon bral sgra sgrogs pad+ma gsung la phyag 'tshal lo: yang dag don ldan badz+ra thugs la phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga nad sel bdud rtsi sman la phyag 'tshal lo: dregs pa 'joms mdzad phur pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'byung ba'i mnga' bdag ma mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: sa dang lam rdzogs rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: bstan pa bsrungs mdzad dam can rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad sngags bdag tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐ḥ rang rig rang shes 'khrul pa bral: mnyam nyid ngang las ye shes shar: kun tu bzang po yab yum la: yid chos dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: mi rtog dbyer med dgongs pa la: ye shes lnga yi 'od mdangs gsal: rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa la: nyon mongs dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: dbyings kyi ngang las bskyed pa'i rgyu: ye shes lnga yi grogs shar ba: dbyings kyi yum chen lnga rnams la: 'byung ba dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes sprul pa mang po'i tshogs: 'gro ba'i don du rang shar ba'i: byang chub sems dpa' brgyad rnams la: rnam shes dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes ngang las yon tan rdzogs: ci 'dod dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad rnams la: yul dus dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: gdug pa 'dul mdzad dpa' bo'i sku: bdag tu 'dzin pa'i skyon dang bral: ta krita sgo ba bzhi rnams la: log lta dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang : btang snyoms bzhi yis 'gro don mdzad: sgo skyong khro mo bzhi rnams la: rtag chad dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: rtog pa drug las 'khor ba drug: ma rig dbang gis byung ba rnams: thugs rjes 'dul 'dzad thub drug la: 'khrul pa dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐ḥ kun tu bzang po rig pa'i rtsal: che mchog gtso la phyag 'tshal lo:

dug lnga ma spang mthar phyin pa'i: he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: dbyings las skur bzhengs thabs shes sbyor: khro mo yum la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs las sprul pa'i gsang chen mo: khro mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: za byed mche gshog pho nya mo: phra men brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gugs 'dren 'ching sdom dgyes mdzad ma: sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jig rten cha lugs sprul pa mo: dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐ḥ ya mān+ta ka gshin rje'i gshed: rngams brjid dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: 'jam dpal sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐ḥ rta mgrin rgyal po dbang gi lha: dbang drag thabs kyi 'khor gyis skor: pad+ma gsung la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐ḥ dpal chen badz+ra he ru ka: rang snang gsal ba'i 'khor gyis bskor: yang dag thugs la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐ḥ bcom ldan che mchog he ru ka: zhi khro rab 'byams lha yis bskor: yon tan rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐ḥ rdo rje gzhon nu phrin las sku: khro bcu 'bar ba'i 'khor gyis bskor: phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐ḥ mngon rdzogs rgyal po he ru ka: 'byung ba lnga las grub pa'i 'khor: ma mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐ḥ rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal: sa dang lam la gnas pa'i 'khor: rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐ḥ gsang ba'i bdag po gos sngon can: 'jig rten dregs pa rnams kyis bskor: bstan pa skyong la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐ḥ stobs ldan nag po mthu rtsal can: drag sngags bdag po mang pos bskor: dgra bgegs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo: de ltar rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: gang gis mtshan thos phyag 'tshal na: dam tshig nyams chag kun byang nas: mtshams med lnga yi sdig pa dag: na rag gnas kyang dong sprugs te: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags: las kyi rnam par smin pa'i skyon: ngag tu mthol la yid kyis bshags: smre sngags bton la gdung bas sbyangs: mos pa'i thal mo snying gar sbyar: dad pas brkyang phyag brdabs te 'tshal:

zhi khro'i lha tshogs mtshan nas brjod: rjes su lus ngag tshugs bcas te: rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bor bsgoms: na rag dong sprugs snying po bzlas: de nas khyed rang rnams lus drang por skyil krung dang bcas rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bor bsgoms la stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gi dmigs pa dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya

sogs sa twa āḥ bar bdun nam nyer gcig brjod/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes sogs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid la thim par mos la sems ma bcos pa'i ngang du dar cig zhog mdzod/ slar brkyang phyag bcas mnyam du gsung bar zhu/ oṃ: chos kyi dbyings nyid spros pa med pa la: bzang ngan gnyis su lta ba yong re gol: dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: spros med bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi: kun tu bzang po bzang ngan med pa la: bzang ngan gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: gtsang dang sme bar 'dzin pa snying re rje: bzang ngan med pa'i klong du bshags par bgyi: mnyam pa nyid la che chung med pa la: sangs rgyas sems can lta ba yong re gol: che chung gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: mnyam nyid bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi: byang chub sems la skye shi med pa la: 'di dang phyi mar lta ba thang re chad: skye shi gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: 'chi med g.yung drung klong du bshags par bgyi: thig le chen po grwa zur med pa la: gzugs dang rdzas su lta ba yong re gol: grwa zur gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: kun nas zlum po thig le chen por bshags: dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: thog ma tha mar lta ba yong re gol: 'pho 'gyur gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: 'gyur ba med pa thig le chen por bshags: rang byung ye shes btsal du med pa la: rgyu 'bras gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: rtsol sgrub gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: btsal ba med pa'i rang byung klong du bshags: rig pa ye shes rtag chad med pa la: rtag chad gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: yod dang med par lta ba nyon re mongs: rtag chad med pa'i ye shes klong du bshags: chos dbyings rnams dag mtha' dbus med pa la: phyogs ris mtha' dbus spro bsdu thang re chad: mtha' dbus gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: chos dbyings rnam dag mtha' dbus med par bshags:

gzhal yas khang la phyi nang med pa la: phyi dang nang du lta ba thang re chad: yangs dogs gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: yangs dogs phyi nang med pa'i klong du bshags: yum gyi mkha' dbyings mtho dman med pa la: steng 'og gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: mtho dman gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: bha ga yangs dogs med pa'i klong du bshags: chos kyi sku la dbye ba med pa la: yul dang sems su lta ba thang re chad: snod bcud gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: gnyis su med pa'i ye shes klong du bshags: ci mdzad ci spyod yab kyi rol pa las: rnam rtog so sor lta ba thang re chad: ming gis log par 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: rol pa 'dzin rtog med pa'i klong du bshags: rig pa'i ye shes nang nas ma shar bas: ma rig rmongs pa'i blo ni snying re rje: gzugs med chos la dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin: ye shes rang bzhin klong du mthol lo bshags: skye ba med pa'i don de ma rtogs na: gang zag 'khrul pa'i blo 'di yong re sdug: skye med chos la nga dang bdag tu bzung : bde chen skye med klong du mthol lo bshags: chos nyid don de blo la ma gsal bas: snang srid sgyu ma yin par ma shes te: zang zing nor la chags pa'i sems ni skyes: chos nyid skye med chags pa med par bshags: 'khor ba rang bzhin med par ma shes te: dngos po mtshan ma'i chos la rtag par 'dzin: mi dge'i las kyis mtshan ma 'jig par byed: byang chub skyon bral klong du mthol lo bshags: mnyam pa'i don la mnyam par ma rtogs pas: gnyen bshes 'khrul pa'i grogs la rtag par 'dzin: mi shes skye bo'i sems 'di yong re gol: mnyam nyid chos kyi klong du mthol lo bshags: chos nyid bden pa'i don dang ma 'phrad na: bden pa'i don bor mi dge'i las la brtson: ston pa'i bka' bor mi chos g.yeng bas bslus: chos nyid bde chen klong du mthol lo bshags: rig pa'i ye shes rang sar ma grol bas:

rang rig don bor g.yeng ba'i las la brtson: 'di 'dra'i don med sems can snying re rje: dbye bsre med pa'i klong du bshags par bgyi: ye shes lha dang srung ma dam tshig can: dam tshig gzhung bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: ma rtogs lta ba'i gol sgrib byung gyur na: rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: yi ge brgya pa brjod cing gral du 'khod do/ /khyad par nang gi sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i phyir/ khyed rang rnams lus drang por sdod/ sems rang babs su klod la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /khyed rang gi lus sha khrag nang khrol gyi rnam pa gang yang med pa stong pa zang thal gur phub pa lta bu bsgom pa'i dbus drang por rtsa gsum po ka ba btsug pa lta bur gnas pa'i yar sne spyi bor tshang bug tu rgya mthong kha phyes pa lta bu ha rer yod pa/ mar sne lte 'og gnyer po che'i thad du rtsa gsum sbubs gcig tu song ba yi ge cha'i dbyibs can ro rkyang gnyis yar sne ltag pa nas thur du gug pa sna bug gnyis su zug pa/ spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lor rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis/ mgrin par ro 'dus kyi 'khor lor rtsa 'dab bcu drug /snying gar dran pa rnam bkod du rtsa 'dab brgyad/ lte bar srid pa skyed byed kyi 'khor lor rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi so so'i gyes mtshams rtsa gsum gcig tu song ba las rtsa 'dab rnams gdugs kyi rtsibs ma brkyang ba lta bur gsal ba'i lte 'og rtsa gsum gyi 'dus mdor pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dmar po tshon gang ba dar dang rus pa dang rin po che sogs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas can yum snyems ma dmar skya gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ bde chen ye shes kyi rang mdangs rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na dgyes ye re bzhugs par mos mdzod la rlung ro sangs kyis bsal bar zhu/

slar 'jam rlung lte bar kha sbyar te tshe rabs nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung tshor ba dang ma tshor ba'i las la 'gyod pa drag pos rnam par sun 'byin/ slan chad sdom sems khyad par can gyis nyes pa las bzlog /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' khyed mkhyen sdig ltung dag pa zhig thugs rje ma chung snyam pa rten gyi stobs/ thabs zab mo gnyen po kun spyod de/ stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas yi ge brgya pa yid bzlas gnang bar zhu/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ yang oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ zhes brjod pa dang chab gcig dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ dad pa'i rnam pas ro rkyang gi rlung gis bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi thugs rgyud bskul te sku las thugs rje ye shes kyi me shin tu phra ba nyug nyug tu 'bar te lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gang*/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa dang des bskyed pa'i sdig ltung spyi dang yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i dam tshig nyams chag khams snyigs ma dang bcas pa bsregs shing sbyangs/ yar mched/ snying gi rtsa 'khor gang*/ gnyid 'thug gi sgrib pa dang des bskyed pa'i sdig ltung spyi dang thugs ky-i dam tshig nyams chag khams snyigs ma dang bcas pa bsregs shing sbyangs/ yar mched/ mgrin pa'i rtsa mkhor gang*/ rmi lam gyis sgrib pa dang des bskyed pa'i sdig ltung spyi dang gsung gi dam tshig nyams chag khams snyigs ma dang bcas pa bsregs shing sbyangs/ yar mched/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang*/ sad pa'i sgrib pa dang des bskyed pa'i sdig ltung spyi dang sku'i dam tshig nyams chag khams snyigs ma dang bcas pa bsregs shing sbyangs pas lhag med du dag par bsam la rlung bsal bar zhu/ sems rang babs su lhod la dar cig mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ slar yang nang gi tshogs bsags khyad par can 'bar 'dzag gi rnal 'byor 'di ltar rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi bcas sngar ltar la/ khyad par ni dbu ma'i yar snar thabs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin ham̐ yig dkar po mgo thur bstan nā dā sum 'khyogs can bde ba'i bdud rtsi dngul chu'i thigs pa ltar 'dzag la khad pa bsal thob/

yang sngar ltar rlung gi rkyen gyis bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sku las gtum mo'i me shin tu phra ba rta rnga rgyar gshags pa tsam nyug nyug tu 'bar te ham̐ yig la phog la khad kyis bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs te me bros ded kyi tshul du rim par spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus na bla ma sku rdo rjai rnam snang yab yum dang*/ rtsa 'dabs kyi sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis mtshon dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsal ba la bde chen dga' ba'i ye shes kyi mchod pa 'bul/ snang stong zung 'jug gi tshogs rdzogaXs/ bum dbang thob/ lus kyi las dang sku yi nyams chag sbyangaXs/ bskyed rim gyi ye shes sminaX/ sku rdo rje sprul sku mngon du gyur pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag par bsam/ mgrin par bla ma gsung rdo rje snang mtha' yab yum dmar po dang*/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum bcu drug gis mtshon dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsal ba la bde chen mchog tu dga' ba'i ye shes kyi mchod pa 'bul/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi tshogs rdzogaXs/ gsang dbang thob/ ngag gi las dang gsung gi nyams chag sbyangaXs/ rlung dang gtum mo'i ye shes sminaX/ gsungs rdo rje longs sku mngon du gyur pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag par bsam/ yang snying gar bla ma thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa yab yum mthing ga dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum brgyad kyis mtshon dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsal ba la bde chen khyad dga'i ye shes kyi mchod pa 'bul/ bde stong zung 'jug gi tshogs rdzogaXs/ sher dbang thob/ yid kyi las dang thugs kyi nyams chag sbyangaXs/ mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes sminaX/ thugs rdo rje chos sku mngon du gyur pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag par bsam/ yang lte bar bla ma ye shes rdo rje rin 'byung yab yum ser po dang*/

rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum drug cu rtsa bzhis mtshon dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsal ba la bde chen lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes kyi mchod pa 'bul/ rig stong zung 'jug gi tshogs rdzogaXs/ tshig dbang thob/ kun gzhi'i las dang yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i nyams chag sbyangaXs/ dbyings rig zung 'jug gi ye shes sminaX/ ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku mngon du gyur pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag par bsam mo/ /mthar bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs gang*/ sbyor mtshams nas byung*/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad bdud rtsis mer gyis gang*/ bde stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skye bar bsam la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ ma hā su kha badz+ra sa twa a haṃḥ zhes rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba chen po nga'o zhes pa'i sngags don dang 'brel ba'i rang gi sgo gsum rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gyur pa'i gsal dag brtan gsum gy-i nga rgyal bzung la/ mthar bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la dar cig 'jog mdzod/ gnyis pa/ de nas byin dbab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ chos thams cad gsal stong nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las rig rtsal snang srid thams cad dur khraud rol pa'i zhing khams chen por gyur pa'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams gnas pa'i go sar seng ge dang pad+ma nyi ma'i khri'i steng du gnyug ma'i lha dang bla ma dbyer med pa'i ngo bo siṃ he shwa ra rnal 'byor spyod pa khrau 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams can sku mdog dmar smug mnyam gzhag dang skyil krung can/ dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku lus kyi cha thams cad rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams til gong kha phyes pa lta bus gang ba/ ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas rdo rje ye shes kyi me khro chung gi tshogs dang bcas pa 'phro bas bdud dang log par 'dren pa thams cad sreg par mdzad pa/

'khor du brgyud gsum gyi bla ma dang dpa' bo 'kha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ smin mtshams su chos 'byung dkar po rtsa ba phra ba dbu ma la zug cing kha gdengs g.yel ba'i zur gcig gyen la bstan pa'i nang bde chen thig le dga' ba 'khyil ba dkar po 'od kyi rnam pa g.yon bskor du drag tu 'khor ba/ de'i thad ka'i nam mkhar ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la rnam pa bi ma la mi tra dkar gsal shangs rtser skye med yi ge āḥdakar pos mtshan pa/ phyag mnyam gzhag bdud rtsi'i thod zhal bsnams pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yog dang chos gos gsol zhing*/ dbu la sde snod gsum mtshon gyi paṇa zhu mnabs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis dgyes ye re bzhugs pa/ snang srid thams cad 'ja' zer thig le mer mer shig shig g.yo ba zhig gsal thob/ slar slob dpon la bī ma la dang siṃ he shwa ra dbyer med pa rigs kun 'dus pa'i khyab bdag chen po dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dung ba zhig byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khyed rang rnams dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med cing gzhal du med pa 'phros/ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings sku gsum dag pa'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i brgyud gsum rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te bsgoms pa 'dra ba'i ye shes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' bar snang gang ba spyan drangs te/ mtsho chen po la kha char bab pa lta bu khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum du sib sib thim pas dbyer med du gyur par mos shig /sha chen gyi spos bsregs/ thod pa'i rnga sgras bskul te/ dbyangs dang bcas pas/ aḥ ngo bo chos sku'i gzhal yas nas: ka dag bla ma gshegs su gsol: rang grol chen por byin phobs la: 'khrul pa dag pa'i dbang mchog skur: rang bzhin longs sku'i zhing khams nas: lhun grub bla ma gshegs su gsol:

rig rtsal chen por byin phob la: ye shes rgyas pa'i dbang mchog skur: thugs rje sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor nas: dbyer med bla ma gshegs su gsol: snang srid gzhir bzhengs byin phobs la: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dbang mchog skur: hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni bde ba che: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i gnas mchog nas: gdod ma'i mgon po he ru ka: siṃ he shwa ra gshegs su gsol: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub na: byin gyis brlab phyir gnas 'dir dgongs: glo bur 'khrul pa'i bar chad sol: 'du 'bral med par dbang skur cig: oṃ ā hūm̐ badz+ra gu ru bi ma la mi tra hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes spyan drangs/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gis byin bsdus nas/ mthar mdun mkhar bzhugs pa'i bi ma la dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang 'od du zhu nas slob ma la thim pas byin rlabs kyi zil 'bar: snang ba bde chen du shar: shes pa gtad med zang thal gyi nyams skye bar bsam: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya sa dbyer med du byas/

de brtan par bya ba'i slad du/ 'o ma dang bcas pa'i dri'i thig le gnas gsum du reg ste: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes brtan par bya'o: de yan chad kyis 'jug pa'i chos so/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa la drug gi dang po/ spros bcas bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ slar slob dpon la mos gus dung dung ba byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer phyag rgya bzhi'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha ye shes pa nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs bar mos la/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i rtse la sgeg sogs lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i tshogs rab 'byams thogs te lha tshogs rnams mchod par mos la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod cing*/ phung khams dag pa gshegs pa gshegs ma'i gdan/ dbang yul dag pa sems dpa' sems ma'i gdan/ yan lag dag pa khro bo khro mo'i gdan/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes rigs lnga'i spyi phyag dang bcas bstod/ de nas rdo rje smin mtshams su btegs te/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar btsal/ /de ltar 'di la'ang stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas gshegs pa rnams kyis dgongs pa mdzad gshegs ma rnams kyis dbang bskur/ /sems dpa' rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ sems ma rnams kyis glu gar dang bcas te me tog 'thor/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs sprad/ kun kyang dbang gi bya ba la dgyes par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyis ni bdag po mchog /ma lus sems can skyed mdzad bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /me tog 'thor te/ dbang lha rnams dang slob dpon lhan gcig pa'i phyag na rin po che'i bum pa bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang bcas te yo ba'i tshul gyis thogs te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ ka dag dbyings kyi bum pa na: lhun grub rig pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs: zung 'jug bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bas: sgo gsum gzung 'dzin dag par shog: dbyangs gsal dang rten 'brel snying po brjod: bum chu ngag tu blud cing gnas bzhir gtor la khrus bya: 'o rigs kyi bu rnams phyi gzung ba'i yul 'od phung du dwangs: nang 'dzin pa'i sems bde chen du grol: rtsa gnas thams cad dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ges shigs se gang bar mos shig /khyad par gyi byin rlabs gud du sbas pa ni/ de'i rjes 'brel du slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po zla ba shar ba lta bu dang*/ rang 'dra'i sku dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang gi dpral ba thim/ lus dang rtsas bskyed pa'i sgrib pa dag /spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob snang srid gzhir bzhengs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang*/ sa brgyad pa non/ 'bras bu lnga thob pa'i skal ba can du byas par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ngar dang ldan pa brjod/ spos rol dang bcas pas byin dbab/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya slob ma la gtad/ oṃ oṃ oṃ zhes mi ldog par rgyas btab/ de nas gnyis pa spros med gsang ba bdud rtsi'i dbang ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi bdag nyid chen por gsal ba rang snang gi shes rab ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i mkha' gsang nas bde ba'i sgra dang*/ 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par sbyan drangs yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes zhu ba bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa yab kyi rdo rje nas/ yum gyi mkha' gsang du babs pa thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang mnyam par sbyar te/ khyed rang rnams ky-i ljags thog tu phul ba la brten nas nyon rlung cha dang bcas pa dag /bde ba chen po'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ āḥ rtsa rlung byang sems bhan+dha ru:

bde chen ye shes bdud rtsis gtams: khyab gdal chen po'i dbang bskur bas: mtshan ma'i rtog pa rang grol shog: dbyangs gsal dang āḥ.āḥ.āḥ zhes brjod la bdud rtsi byin pasaḥ bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i dbus kyi thig le stong pa'i sgron ma la thimaḥ de las bdud rtsi cher 'phel bas rtsa gnas thams cad khyab pas bde gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i nyams skye bar bsam la: rlung bum pa can 'dzin du bcug la drag tu gcun no/ /mthar rtsa gnas kyi yi ge rnams kyang 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim pas mtshan ma'i rtog pa thams cad dbyings su nub par bsam la dar cig mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ de brtan byed du/ slob dpon gyi mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'char ka'i zer thag lta bu dang ā li kā li'i phreng ba dpag tu med pa lu gu rgyud du byung*/ khyed rang gi mgrin par thim/ ngag dang rlung gi sgrib pa dag /spros med gsang ba'i dbang thob/ skye med rang byung rdo rje'i bzlas pa la dbang*/ sa bcu gcig pa non/ 'bras bu gsung lnga thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ āḥ zhes spos rol dang bcas byin dbab/ āḥ.āḥ.āḥ zhes rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas gsum pa shin tu spros pa med pa brda yi dbang ni/ slob ma rnams kyi lus rdo rje rtse lnga me 'od 'bar bar bsgoms la rdo rje'i 'dug stangs byed du gzhug lang 'dug gnyis las 'dir 'dug pa phyag srol yin/ mchan/ la/ ngag tu hūm̐ gi glu blang zhing snang srid thams cad hūm̐ gi gzugs dang sgras gang bar bsam: yid dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad la mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ ces brda sprad la bla slob rnams kyi hūm̐ sgra brjod cing*/ mthar sems ma bcos pa'i ngang la dar cig mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ slar bla mas phaṭa: ces drag tu brjod pas nyams de las sad pa na: rigs drug gi 'gro ba thams cad kyi lus kyi rnam 'gyur: ngag gi sgra skad:

sems kyi bde sdug thams cad wal gyis yid la byas te skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'i dbyings su ngal bso'o: zhes gsungs pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis dmyal ba tsha grang dang bcad gtub sogs kyi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags bkres skom sogs kyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro glen lkugs bkol spyod sogs kyi sdug bsngal/ mi skye rga na 'chi sogs kyi bde sdug /lha ma yin 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal/ lha 'chi 'pho ltung ba sogs so so'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur/ ngag gi sgra skad/ sems kyi bde sdug thams cad yud tsam la sgo gsum gyis myong ba'i mos pa yid la gyis shig /ces brda sprad la bsam du gzhug /mthar de thams cad dbyings las byung zhing dbyings su thim pa yin par shes pa'i ngang la dar cig mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ rdo rje sems dpa'i me long du 'ja' tshon 'phro ba bstan te: hūm̐: ma skyes stong pa shel lta bu: ma 'gags gsal ba 'ja' tshon bzhin: dbyer med rig pa'i snying po can: 'od gsal nges don rtogs par gyis: a aḥ zhes ngo sprad: 'o/ rigs kyi bu nyon cig /chos nyid gshis kyi gnas lugs skye med ka dag spros bral 'dus ma byas pa'i rang gdangs 'gags med du gsal ba sku dang thig le ste dbyer med rig pa'i snying po can du ye nas rang chas su bzhugs pa'i brda rdo rje sems dpa'i me long gis mtshon pa'i don go bar gyis shig /mi 'gyur ba'i gzer gdab pa'i phyir: lus drang por bsrang : rlung rtsol med du bzhag: mig bar snang du har re blta: sems da lta'i shes pa skad cig ma'i ngang du 'dzin med lhug par dar cig 'jog mdzod: de brtan byed du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po mthing zhun gyi dwangs ma lta bu dang*/ a yig mthing gsal dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang gi snying gar thim/ yid dang thig le'i sgrib pa dag /shin tu spros med sher dbang thob/

bde chen 'od gsal gyi ye shes bsgom pa la dbang*/ sa bcu gsum pa non/ 'bras bu thugs lnga thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ āḥ zhes spos rol dang bcas byin dbab/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ zhes rgyas gdab bo: bzhi pa rab tu spros med don gyi dbang ni: dpon slob thams cad lus gcer bur phyung : stod g.yog gsal ba phyag bzhes yin/ mchan/ slob dpon mnyam gzhag skyil krung drang por dgongs pa la gnas pa'i thugs kar a yig mthing gsal mar me ltar 'bar ba la sems gzung du gzhug /zin pa na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes drag pos byin dbab/ nyams skyes pa na phaṭ ces 'phro bcad la ma bcos pa'i ngang du klod: de'i tshe sems nyid stong pa: gsal ba: rig pa'i snying po can du mthong ba ni sku gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'o/ /lnga pa lhun grub snang bzhi bzhugs stangs dang lta stangs gsum gyi rten 'brel la brten dgos pas dang po ni/ chos sku'i bzhugs stangs seng ge'i khyi tshugs ni lus tsog pu'i rkang mthil gnyis mdun du sprod/ lus kyi cha bsrang*/ mgo rtsal mjing pa la bskur/ lag sor gnyis nang du bsgongs te rkang mthil sprad pa'i long mo gnyis kyi nang thad drang du btsugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa longs sku'i bzhugs stangs glang po che nyal ba lta bu ni/ lus kha sbubs su byas la pus mo gnyis brang la sbyar/ gru mo gnyis sa la btsug /thal mo gnyis kyis ol gong btegs/ rkang pa'i phyi rting gnyis 'phong la sbyar/ sor mo phyir 'phul te bskum pa'o/ /gsum pa sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs drang srong lta bu ni/ lus tsog bur 'dug /rkang mthil gnyis sa la phab/ sgal tshig drang por bsrang*/ pus mo gnyis brang la sbyar/ sgyu zhabs yid tsam 'then nas sgal par bcal/ lag pa re mig ltar bsnol nas pus mor bkab/ de nas mchan khung du reg /gru mo gnyis pus mo'i steng du bzhag ste lag sor sgong bas lkaug ma btegs pa rnams so/

/bzhugs stangs rnams bla mas dal bus brjod de slob mas de dag mi nor ba lag len du theb nges dgos so/ /ngag rlung shin tu dal bar brten: mig gzigs stangs gsum gyis dbyings la gzir: zhes gsungs pa'i don chos sku'i gzigs stangs gyen/ longs sku'i gzigs stangs zur/ sprul sku'i gzigs stangs mthur du phabs te blta ba rnams yin no/ /de lta bu'i bzhugs stangs gzigs stangs rlung gnad dang bcas pas/ dbyings rig dbyer med du mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ ces brda sprad do/ /drug pa de ltar gnad gsum la brten te nyams su blang na snang bzhi mthar phyin par nges pa rdo rje tshig 'di la gsan par zhu/ slob dpon gyi dgongs pa mi g.yo ba'i ngang nas: aḥ sku gsum bzhugs stangs gzigs stangs kyis: dbang po'i mchog ni dbyings la gzir: mngon sum mthong ba gong 'phel nas: tshad phebs zad sar phyin par 'gyur: zhes ngo sprad: de brtan byed du slob dpon gyi gnas gsum ka nas 'od zer 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu dang : tsit+ta rin po che'i sbubs nas 'od lnga'i gong bu tshon gang ba byung*/ khyed rang gi gnas gsum dang*/ snying dbus su thim/ cha mnyam yid shes kyi sgrib pa dag /rab tu spros med bzhi pa thob/ ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug bsgom pa la dbang*/ ye shes bla ma'i sa non/ 'bras bu yon tan dang phrin las lnga lnga 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a a aḥ zhes mi ldog par rgyas gdab bo: de nas spro ba bskyed cing smon lam gdab pa 'di la gsan pas khyab ste/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya slob ma la gtad de/ lce btsun siṃ he shwa ra'i zhal nas 'das rjes 'byung 'gyur smon lam gyi mgur ma thos pas grol ba 'di nyid la sems gtod la de ltar 'gyur ba'i smon 'dun bzang po gyis/ zhes dbyangs dang bcas/ e ma smyon pa seng dbang nga :

las kyi rlung zad ye shes rgyas: ma rig sgo lnga'i sbubs las grol: rang rig 'od gsal sbubs su zhugs: sgo gsum gyi 'khrul pa zhig tsa na: 'khrul gzhi thams cad ya re cha: 'khrul snang gi mdud pa chod tsa na: sems 'dzin zer ba thang re chad: 'khrul pa ye shes su shar tsa na: dag snang thams cad bslu ba'i chos: thams cad dbyings su thim tsa na: ci yang ma yin cir yang 'char: e ma e ma dam pa'i sku drin lags: e ma 'da' ka'i tshig 'di snying po'i don: snying phyung lag mthil bzhag pa 'di las med: tshig gi tha ma dus mthar snang bar shog: zag pa rang zad 'byung ba rang sar dengs: dran pa rang grol zang thal 'od kyi lus: seng ge dbang phyug nyid dang mnyam par shog: ces brjod la me tog 'thor/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa la gnyis kyi dang po bka' gtad pa ni/ khyed rang rnams gnyugs ma don gyi he ru ka'i nga rgyal la gnas par mdzod/ ces brda sprad la/ de nas bka' srung gi gtor ma la dpal 'bar ram spos thur btsugs la chos skyong 'khor bcas su gsal ba slob ma'i lag tu gtad la/ aḥ dbyings las ye shes rang shar ba'i: e ka ṭī ral gcig ma: 'od gsal rig pa zang thal skuḥ khyab 'jug chen po sgra can 'dzin: zung 'jug dwangs ma'i thig le 'dzin: rdo rje dgra 'dul legs pa rtsal: thugs rje'i cho 'phrul bsam yas pa: 'bum phrag dregs pa'i sde tshogs kun: dgongs brda snyan nas brgyud pa yi: rgyal ba rig 'dzin rnal 'byor dbang : ji snyed 'dus pa'i tshogs chen dang : 'khor 'das zil gnon he ru ka: dpal chen siṃ he shwa ra yis: ji ltar bka' bsgos dam bzhag bzhin: dur khrod rol pa'i gnas 'dir byon: khams lnga dag pa'i sman phud dang : 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma ba liṃ ta: dug lnga bsgral ba'i dmar chen po: dpal gyi pham phab chen por bzhes: dam ldan rdo rje'i slob ma la: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: theg mchog lam du zhugs pa la: glo bur bdud bzhi'i bar chad zlog:

'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba'i tshe: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i sa bon sgrol: rig pa ka dag lta ba la: yid byed mtshan ma'i rtog pa srungs: rig rtsal mngon sum snang ba'i tshe: rlung sems 'gyu ba dbyings su non: mthar thug gzhi dbyings gnyug ma'i klong : gzhi snang rig pa'i phrin las sgrubs: sa ma ya hoḥ zhes dang spro na tshig lhug pas bka' bsgo ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ /sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ /mkhas pa shrī siṃ ha/ paṇa chen dzñā na sū tra/ slob dpon bi ma mi tra/ nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po/ ldang ma lhun grub rgyal mtshan/ lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug /kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer/ bdag cag gi dpal mgon bla ma dam pa 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje la sogs rig 'dzin bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang tha tshig la bzhag pa'-i/ rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma/ zab mo bka' gter gyi drod 'dzin/ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso mo dpal ldan sngags srung e ka dza ṭī/ dregs pa sde brgyad yongs kyi spyi rje/ skye 'gro'i srog gi bdag po gza' bdud rā hu la/ 'dzam gling srid pa'i bdag po sgrol ging chen po rdo rjai dgra 'dul legs pa rtsal la sogs/ snying tig bka' gter gyi bka' srung bstan srung*/ gter srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas/ srung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ nad dang gdon bgegs bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes yon tan thams cad rgyas pa dang*/ rlung sems snang ba/ snang srid dbang du sdud pa dang*/ phas kyi rgol ba dang*/ lta log bsam sbyor ngan pa'i sde tshogs thams cad tshar gcod pa dang bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/

mdor na snying tig snying po'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las dam pa skad cig la g.yel ba med par mdzad du gsol/ chos skyong 'khor bcas kyis de de bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes par bsam mo/

/slar gtor ma rang gnas su bzhag go /de ltar legs par grub 'phral/ bkra shis par bya ba'i slad du/ nam mkha' gang ba'i rgyal ba sras bcas brgyud gsum rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro bla ma dang chab gcig tu bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs dang bcas pas me tog man+dā ra ba'i char chen po phyogs kun tu bsnyil nas dge legs kyi snang ba chen pos rab tu rgyas par byas pa'i mos pa 'dzod cig /ces brda sbyar te bkra shis ci rigs brjod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ spro na spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig gi rnam bzhag rgyas bsdus 'tshams pas skabs dbye mi spro na/ de ltar smin grol rim can la ma ltos par 'di ni gdams ngag dbang gi lugs su gdab pa zhes bya ste smin grol gnyis zung 'jug tu thob pa yin pas/ zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ rtsa ba sku gsung thugs mchog dang : yan lag dam tshig nyi shu lnga: med dang gcig pu phyal ba sogs: cho ga bzhin du bsrung bar bgyi: lan gsum/ slar yang dbang thob pa'i gtang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod dge tshogs dang bcas pa yongs su 'bul na cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /khyod la bdag kyang yongs su 'bul/ /slob mar bzung ste spyad par gsol/ dge tshogs bsngau ba spy-i ltar bya'o/ /klong gsal las/ dga' ston bar chad sel ba dang*/ /yon tan kun rdzogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ thal 'gyur las/ 'khor dang longs spyod rnams kyi rten/ /lus ngag spyod pas mnyes pa yin/ /bla ma sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor brten/ /brten pa de la yon tan ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba yi/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa thob/

/ces gsungs pa ltar/ yon gyi mnyes par bya ba dang*/ tshogs kyis rdzas la longs spyad cing rdo rje glu blang zhing smon lam rgya cher gdab/ lhag ma sogs cho ga'i bya ba rnams mthar chags su grub par bya'o/ /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i bdud rtsi'i char bzang pos/ /glo bur khams kyi dri ma kun sbyangs nas/ /rgyu bzhi rdo rje'i sa bon gsos thebs te/ /sku dang ye shes dam pa myur smin shog /ces kho bo cag rjes su bzung ba'i skabs su bsag sbyang sogs bzhed srol ji lta ba 'khrul med bklag chog bgyis pa la slar rang blor bstun te/ rig 'dzin sna tshogs rang grol pas lhag bsam dri ma med pas sbyar ba rnam pa kun tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// // PAGE PAGE 20 FILENAME S-19.doc
